system.description:
This spell removes a curse from a creature or item. Some very powerful curses may not be removable with this spell.

Reverse: Curse gives the target a curse unless they can make a spell save. The exact nature of the curse is up to the caster, although the following are typical effects.

■ Something that produces up to a –4 penalty to attacks (e.g., Blindness) ■ Something that produces up to a –2 penalty on one type of saves (such as a susceptibility to poison) ■ Something that produces up to a –4 penalty to social interactions (such as smelling like a corpse) ■ Something that causes a halving of a single ability score (such as withering of a limb).

Using the Curse spell to inflict effects other than things on this list requires the Gameguide's permission.
